summary: Added optional readingMinutes to the typed post schema and Sveltia form, accepting whole numbers from 1 through 60. Article details render N min read only when supplied. Existing content and visual tokens were preserved. Temporary acceptance posts and the browser harness were removed, then the original content was rebuilt successfully.

checks.result: Passed; reported static-sveltia, typed content and editor entry points, and available static verification commands.
Unavailable for this trial; no MCP operations were possible.
Passed before source implementation; existing Art Direction Record was structurally valid.

Passed: script/template lint, CSS contracts, art direction, token audit, 43 tests, and Astro check with 0 errors/warnings/hints. Boundary validator tests accepted undefined, 1, 30, 60 and rejected 0, -1, 61, 1.5, 59.5, numeric/text/empty strings, null, boolean, NaN and Infinity. Form constraint tests passed.

checks.command: npm run build with temporary readingMinutes 1 and 60 posts (via runner)
checks.result: Passed; both boundary posts and the existing omitted-value post generated successfully.

checks.command: npm run test -- tests/reading-acceptance.mjs using temporary Edge browser harness (via runner)
checks.result: Initial attempt failed because the msedge browser executable was unavailable. Existing 43 tests passed. No browser was installed.

checks.command: npm run test -- tests/reading-acceptance.mjs using installed Chromium (via runner)
checks.result: Passed all 44 tests. Temporary browser acceptance verified visible 1 min read and 60 min read on detail pages at 320, 768 and 1280px; omitted value remained absent; no horizontal overflow. Emitted homepage and posts listing contained no reading label. Harness was removed afterward.

checks.command: npm run build with temporary readingMinutes 1.5 (via runner)
checks.result: Expected failure: Astro InvalidContentEntryDataError on readingMinutes, requiring int. Temporary invalid post was removed afterward.

checks.command: npm run build after removing all temporary content (via runner)
checks.result: Passed; original four public pages built, including welcome without readingMinutes, and release artifact postbuild passed.

checks.command: npm run check:dev-tools after final build (via runner)
checks.result: Passed; no styleguide route, fixture specimens, or server entrypoint in final static release.

outsideRunnerReads.reason: Runner MCP was unavailable. Consulted official documentation for number widget value_type, min/max/step, optional empty values and validation before pairing the browser form with the typed schema. No external credentials or account data were accessed.
